section: Non-residents: employment income
label: Who is a non-resident taxpayer (beschränkt steuerpflichtig)
value: Someone with neither a home (Wohnsitz) nor a habitual abode (gewöhnlicher Aufenthalt) in Austria; taxed only on the Austrian income listed in § 98 EStG, such as pay for work done in Austria
note: Tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work in Austria. A non-resident may also file voluntarily to recover wage tax; the add-back then applies. Incoming scientists and researchers: see the inbound regime section.
source_title: Bundesabgabenordnung, § 26 (RIS); EStG 1988 § 1 (2) and (3) (https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/1988/400/P1/NOR40274820)

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: Residence test
value: A home kept and used, or a habitual abode; a stay in Austria of more than 6 months always makes the person fully taxable, from the first day (§ 26 BAO)
note: Tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work in Austria. A non-resident may also file voluntarily to recover wage tax; the add-back then applies. Incoming scientists and researchers: see the inbound regime section.
source_title: Bundesabgabenordnung, § 26 (RIS); EStG 1988 § 1 (2) and (3) (https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/1988/400/P1/NOR40274820)

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: How wage tax is withheld
value: The Austrian employer withholds wage tax on the normal tariff, as for any other employee
note: Tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work in Austria. A non-resident may also file voluntarily to recover wage tax; the add-back then applies. Incoming scientists and researchers: see the inbound regime section.
source_title: BMF: Einkünfte aus nichtselbständiger Arbeit mit Auslandsbezug (last updated 1 January 2026); EStG 1988 § 102 (3) (https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/1988/400/P102/NOR40274903, version for 2026)

section: Contractors: employment test, free service contracts and withholding
label: Official test: employee or self-employed
value: The facts decide, not the contract's name: an employee owes personal work for a period, follows the employer's instructions, is integrated in the business (working time, place and tools set by the employer) and bears no business risk; the overall picture decides (§ 47 EStG, § 4 (2) ASVG)
note: Where the facts show employment, a contract named a works contract or free service contract still counts as employment for tax and social insurance.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Corporate income tax (Körperschaftsteuer) [national]
value: 23% flat on taxable income; minimum tax €500 a year (GmbH) or €3,500 (AG); 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least €750,000,000. Paid by companies with their seat or management in Austria, and foreign companies on their Austrian income. KStG 1988 §§ 22 and 24; Mindestbesteuerungsgesetz.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, social insurance and payroll levies are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
value: no branch profits tax (branches pay 23% corporate tax); 27.5% KESt on dividends (23% may be withheld for company shareholders). Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company). KStG 1988 §§ 21 and 22; EStG 1988 §§ 27a and 93.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, social insurance and payroll levies are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Self-employed contributions (SVS, GSVG) [national]
value: pension 18.5%, health 6.8% and self-employed provision 1.53% of the contribution base; accident insurance €12.96 a month; base from €551.10 to €8,085 a month. Paid by self-employed people (trade licence holders and new self-employed). Gewerbliches Sozialversicherungsgesetz (GSVG).
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, social insurance and payroll levies are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Contractor or employee: Dienstvertrag, freier Dienstvertrag, Werkvertrag [national]
value: the facts decide (instructions, integration, personal work, business risk); free employees are insured under § 4 (4) ASVG but pay no wage tax; 20% withholding on certain payments to non-residents; client reports above €900 a year. Paid by clients (social insurance and payroll levies for free employees; withholding on payments to non-residents). EStG 1988 §§ 47, 99, 100 and 109a; ASVG §§ 4 and 412a to 412d (Sozialversicherungs-Zuordnungsgesetz).
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, social insurance and payroll levies are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: BMF: Merkmale eines Dienstverhältnisses and Unterschied Dienstvertrag – freier Dienstvertrag/Werkvertrag (both last updated 1 January 2026); ASVG § 4 (2) (RIS, https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/1955/189/P4/NOR40242654)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Simplified regimes: flat-rate expenses (Basispauschalierung) and the small business exemption (Kleinunternehmerregelung) [national]
value: expenses at 15% (at most €63,000) or 6% (at most €25,200) of turnover up to €420,000; small-business flat rate 45% or 20%; turnover tax exemption up to €55,000; no presumptive income tax. Paid by no one: optional regimes for small businesses. EStG 1988 § 17; UStG 1994 § 6 (1) Z 27.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, social insurance and payroll levies are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Einkommensteuergesetz 1988, § 17 (RIS, version in force since 30 July 2026)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Non-resident tax on employment income (beschränkte Steuerpflicht) [national]
value: wage tax on the normal tariff, withheld by the employer, without Familienbonus Plus and the sole earner credits; €11,077 added to income on assessment; EU and EEA nationals may opt to be taxed as residents (90% test). Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). EStG 1988 §§ 1, 70, 98 and 102; BAO § 26.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, social insurance and payroll levies are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

value: assessed value × base rate (0.05% to 0.2%) × municipal multiplier of up to 500%; 1% Bodenwertabgabe on undeveloped building land above €14,600. Paid by property owners. Grundsteuergesetz 1955; Finanzausgleichsgesetz 2024 § 17; Bodenwertabgabegesetz 1960.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Property transfer tax (Grunderwerbsteuer) and land register fee [national]
value: 3.5% on purchases; 0.5%, 2% and 3.5% stepped tariff on gifts, inheritances and family transfers; land register fee 1.1% (mortgage 1.2%); the first-home fee exemption ended on 30 June 2026. Paid by the parties to the transaction (usually the buyer by contract). Grunderwerbsteuergesetz 1987 § 7; Gerichtsgebührengesetz Tarifpost 9.
